messages:
Sam: Heads-up — tiny holiday hangout in the break lounge Friday 3pm. low-commitment: 20 mins, cookies, weird ornaments, optional carol-off. Anyone in? :sunglasses:
Noor: In! I'll bring a batch of my dad's cinnamon crisps (they're slightly intimidating but edible). Also, I nominate a 'worst-wrapped gift' award. :wrapped_gift:
Marco: Count me in. I have a suspiciously ornate mini snow globe to surrender to the swap. Also bringing battery-powered fairy lights.
Jen: I'll bring a playlist and a 'desk ornament restoration kit' (tape, glue, questionable glitter). Also can we do a postcard corner? people write 2-line good wishes and drop them in a jar.
Diego: Love the postcard idea. Also proposing a 30-second carol-off: anyone who carols must perform with a kitchen utensil as an instrument. Rules are binding. :drum_with_drumsticks:
Sam: calendar-bot, can you make this public and add a 20-min buffer? Some of us have meetings that overrun.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Break Lounge: Micro-Holiday & Carol-Off" 123 Friday 3:00 PM 120 30 min 124 Attendees: Sam, Noor, Marco, Jen, Diego
Noor: PSA: label your food please. I have mild egg sensitivity. Also if anyone's bringing candles, maybe skip them? Fire alarm is unamused.
Marco: noted. no open flames from me. Also bringing napkins.
Jen: Tiny meme contest idea: post your meme in the thread during the event, highest :laughing: reactions wins a consolation prize (a single, slightly dented tinsel).
Diego: I will win with a 'reindeer in meeting' GIF I saved from 2017. Brace yourselves.
Sam: Also, for those who can't make it, I'll live-post a 1-line holiday hello and a terrible pun. Remote friends welcome to drop memes.
Noor: Love it. Quick poll: snack preferences? sweet, savory, both. Reply with the word.
Marco: savory
Jen: both
Diego: sweet
Sam: both
Noor: perfect. See you Friday! :sparkles:
